title: Field forms
subtitle: Reusable checklists and field forms. Optional module - photos use Documents. Acknowledgement is operational only: not a legal electronic signature.
acknowledgementDisclaimer: This is operational acknowledgement only: a typed name and timestamp for internal sign-off. It is not a legal electronic signature, not e-sign, and not a substitute for a legally binding signature.

photoNote.title: Photos via Documents
photoNote.body: Save the draft first, then attach photos from the submission page. Photos use the existing Documents storage - not a separate gallery.
